air canada.notes: NOT YET VERIFIED for US-Guatemala routings. Air Canada appears only on connections via YYZ/YUL; a US-GUA itinerary routed through Canada also means clearing Canadian transit requirements. Verify before trusting.

american.notes: First checked bag to Central America (except Panama) is $45 online / $50 airport; Basic Economy adds $5, so $50 online. Per person, EACH WAY. Carry-on plus personal item are free on ALL fare types including Basic Economy. Fees updated for tickets issued on/after 2026-05-18.

avianca.notes: Light/XS/S fares include NO free checked bag; first bag ~$50 added online 48h+ before departure, rising to ~$120 at the airport. Since 2026-01-27 Basic includes a free 10kg carry-on on international routes. Book bags online early - the airport price is more than double.

copa.notes: STRONG VALUE. Economy Basic has no free checked bag but an added bag is only ~$30 online (vs $45-50 on US legacy carriers). Economy Classic INCLUDES one free checked bag - if Classic costs less than ~$30 more than Basic, take Classic. Free 10kg carry-on AND personal item on every fare including Basic. Checked allowance 23kg/50lb.

delta.notes: First checked bag US-Central America $45, second $55; can vary by specific route. Delta permits a full carry-on plus personal item on Basic Economy. Re-verify the carry-on rule at booking, it is the least well sourced field here.

frontier.notes: WATCH THIS ONE. Checked bag ~$53-63 if added during booking, and it RISES at check-in, at the counter, and at the gate. Carry-on is NOT free: $53-117 depending on route/date/when purchased. Only the personal item (14x18x8in) is free. A cheap Frontier fare can lose to a pricier legacy fare once a checked bag is added. Fees are route- and date-specific: use Frontier's own bag price checker for the exact itinerary before booking.

jetblue.notes: First checked bag $39 prepaid online off-peak, $49 peak - December holidays are peak, so assume $49. JetBlue now allows a free full carry-on plus personal item on EVERY fare including Blue Basic.

spirit.notes: Spirit Airlines CEASED OPERATIONS on 2026-05-02. Priced at 999 so any stale Spirit inventory sorts to the bottom rather than surfacing as a fake bargain.

united.notes: First checked bag $45 online for US-Central America ($70 range at airport / on some Basic fares). IMPORTANT: Guatemala counts as SHORT-HAUL international, where United Basic Economy allows a PERSONAL ITEM ONLY - no full-size carry-on. The free-carry-on rule people cite applies to transatlantic/transpacific/South America, not Central America. carryon_usd is 0 because it cannot be bought on Basic; you must buy up to a Standard Economy fare.

volaris.notes: DISQUALIFIER RISK: Volaris checked allowance is commonly 33lb/15kg, NOT 50lb. You require 0-50lb, so a Volaris fare may not actually satisfy the requirement without buying extra weight. Zero fare includes personal item only; carry-on ~$50. Verify the weight limit for the specific fare before booking.
